Code on `origin/main` (`03865ae9`) was read to judge the text, never reviewed.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set: unchanged. No schema, rule, validator or constant is in the diff, so nothing an author may write is added or refused by this PR. Right.
- Public surface: the published text of five skills in `@objectstack/skills` changes; no export, no served `*.generated.ts`, no token ceiling moves. Right.
- Eval fixtures: eval 10 of the data skill loses two `must_not_contain` entries (an answer keeping `required: true` on a boolean no longer fails), and eval 11 of the i18n skill loses the `fallbackLocale: 'en'` `must_contain` entry. Both loosen an assertion to follow behaviour on `main` and a recorded ruling (#35245 comment 6998116920; card #35569 item 2). Right.
- Gate verdicts (the check-runs on this head): every concluded run is `success` or `skipped`, none failed. Among them `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Test Core`, `Check Changeset`, `PR-body guards` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` are `success`.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/35245-skills-publish-time-findings.md` declares `@objectstack/skills: patch`. The diff publishes wording only, in one package, so patch is the right level. `Check Changeset` concluded `success`.

Clause-②: no — the PR body and the changeset both carry `Clause-②: no`, and that is correct: the checks the text names were merged earlier by other PRs; this diff narrows nothing.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Open question 1 of dev report 7024103427 (no text for `action-no-object-binding` in the first surface): answered A by claim amendment 7024130793; the clause is in `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` on this head. Closed, with finding S1 below on the same file.
- Open question 2 of the same report (keep eval 10's two `required: true` entries removed): answered A by the same amendment. I agree: ruling 6998116920 says `required` on a boolean is legitimate, and the engine's `required` arm refuses only a missing, null or empty value (`isEmptyForRequired`, `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts`).
- Open question of dev report 7024203128 (who patches the PR body): answered in fact, the body on this head carries the ui-skill item.
- Measured contradictions in the dev report: the door set holds 21 names on `main`, not 19, and the text states no count; `flow-node-type-no-executor` is judged only by a running server, and the text says "at a server's publish". Both handled correctly in the text.
- Deviations (model-free commit trailers, moved base, unsquashed WIP commits): process only, no contract effect.
- Security line: `yes`, because two changed hunks restate security-adjacent guidance while paying tokens: the `http` row of the automation skill (where a credential may not be written) and the placement paragraph of the ui actions rule (the write capability a script body needs). The i18n hunk also names permission-denial messages. I compared old and new wording in each: the meaning is unchanged. The seat adopting this record adds the `security` label.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, the diff has no code, no query and no id materialisation.

### ④ Design judgment

Each `hits` file was read at this head against the code it teaches on `main`.

- `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` — holds. `MCP_DOOR_TOOL_NAMES` is in the same file as source 2 (`packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts`), contains `query_records`, `run_action` and both file tools, and `validate-ai-tool-references.ts` adds it only when `mcpPrompt` is not `false`; on a `mcpPrompt: false` skill a door-only name still warns with its own message and hint. Card #35460 asked for exactly this and for no count.
- `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` — holds. `flow-node-type-no-executor` judges only with a sealed vocabulary, which only the runtime publish gate hands in. `flow-http-timeout-missing` is a `warning`. The seven shortened rows lose no fact.
- `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` — holds. `state-machine-no-initial-states` is an `error` on an active machine whose `events` are absent or include `insert`; `events: ['update']` is exempt (`validate-inert-object-declarations.ts`). The false "omit to keep the legacy behavior" line is gone. `flow-approval-decision-unrouted` matches the labels `approve` and `reject` exactly and is an `error`. The file's own examples label their edges `approve` / `reject` and declare `initialStates`.
- `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` — holds. The boolean bullet matches the ruling and the engine. The inline rule parses against `ScriptValidationSchema` (snake_case `name`, `type: 'script'`, a CEL envelope `condition`, `message`), and its predicate is the failure condition, as the schema requires. The state-machine paragraph matches the rule.
- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/validation.md` — holds. The shortened JSON example is still a valid machine with `initialStates`; dropping `severity` leaves the schema default `error`; no later text refers to the removed states.
- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` — holds. Eval 10 follows the ruling; eval 11's prompt is an insert-running machine, so `initialStates: ['draft']` stays the right answer.
- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` and `skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json` — hold. Refusal labels are resolved with the request's locale and the declared `sourceLocale` as the authored language (`packages/objectql/src/engine-validation-messages.ts`, and the denial path in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts`). No other text in `skills/objectstack-i18n/` teaches `fallbackLocale` as a refusal workaround; the remaining mentions are the config example, the table row and eval 1.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` — the new clause is correct against `validate-action-object-binding.ts` (an `error`, on the three CLI commands and on the runtime door for an `action` write; both fixes are the rule's own hint), but the file now contradicts itself:

S1 (should-fix) — `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, section "Opening in a New Tab", the checked example `PrintA3Action` (`name: 'crm_print_a3'`): it declares `locations: ['list_toolbar']` and no `objectName`. The file's first line says actions are registered under `defineStack({ actions: [...] })`, and the paragraph this PR rewrites says that `locations` without `objectName` is refused at validate and publish (`action-no-object-binding`). An author who copies that example gets the refusal the same file describes. It is the only example in the file with a non-empty `locations` and no `objectName`. Fix: give the example an `objectName` (the neighbouring examples use `lead`). The file sits at 3708 of 3711 tokens, so the added line is paid for in the same file. The example predates this PR, but card #35245's scope is the skills text that teaches each trap, and this example teaches it by showing it.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract):

- N1 (nit) — `state-machines-and-approvals.md`, "On approve / on reject": "both branches would run" is exact for a misspelled pair; with a single out-edge the unclaimed decision takes that one edge. The rule's own wording is "a decision no edge claims runs every out-edge".
- N2 (nit) — automation `SKILL.md`, `http` row: "set `timeoutMs`, or it has no timeout and warns" does not say that a `durable: true` node or a node-level `timeoutMs` also silences the warning. The same row already teaches `durable: true`.
- N3 (nit) — automation `SKILL.md`, "a `type` none runs": "none" has no clear antecedent; "a `type` no executor runs" is the rule's phrase.

No must-fix. One should-fix: S1. It earns a delta review of its fix.
